items.title: Stopping GLP-1s associated with increased risk of heart attack and stroke, study finds
items.summary: Stopping GLP-1 treatment is associated with a substantially increased risk of heart attack, stroke or death, a new study has found.

items.title: MPs call for wider access to weight-loss drugs for people with obesity
items.summary: Influential MPs have called on NHS England (NHSE) to “urgently reassess” what they called its current “unambitious” plan for rolling out weight-loss injections, which relies heavily on nursing staff.

items.title: Greater national oversight needed for obesity treatment, urges parliamentary committee
items.summary: Services to treat obesity should be ‘overhauled and reimagined’, a cross-party parliamentary committee has said. The Health and Social Care Committee is urging the government to reframe obesity as a ‘chronic, relapsing condition with life-long physiological impacts’ and adapt how patients receive treatment.

items.title: MPs demand weight management overhaul amid ‘unambitious’ Mounjaro rollout
items.summary: NHS weight management care needs to be completely overhauled, say MPs who found poor access to a range of treatments, including drugs and surgery. The Health and Social Care Committee said obesity should be treated as a long-term, managed condition like diabetes.

items.title: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro®) for managing obesity – patient leaflet
Counterfeit weight loss jabs worth £2m seized in Birmingham raid
items.summary: More than 12,000 counterfeit weight loss medicine jabs worth around £2m have been seized in a raid on an industrial unit in Birmingham.

items.title: ASA clamps down on rule-breaking pharmacy weight-loss medicine adverts
items.summary: The Advertising Standards Agency (ASA) has clamped down for the first time on online promotion of oral weight loss drugs. It found two online pharmacies had broken the rules by promoting unlicenced medicines and prescription-only medicines to the public in adverts for oral GLP-1 treatments.
